commitMessage: fix: DSP pointer stability for multi-page VLM + regression gate green
notes: Fixed testCompatStringSplit_1: NDArray::buffer() in NDArray.hXX crashed with 'Unexpected error with data type UTF8 (ID: 50)' because BUILD_SINGLE_SELECTOR with SD_COMMON_TYPES_ALL does not include UTF8/UTF16/UTF32. Added explicit guard before the selector macro: if dataType is UTF8/UTF16/UTF32, return _bufferWithOffset<int8_t>(0, getDataBuffer()) directly. Fix in NDArray.hXX buffer() method at line 2744.
